## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

ExerciseSessionSystemImpl — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sensor/session/ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.kt

## Trigger

ExerciseSessionManager.close(), calling endExerciseSession(), is called
by StopRaceController.stop() and by EndOfRaceViewModel's init block —
observed. ExerciseSessionManager.onInteractivityChanged(), calling
setDataDeliveryMode(mode), exists on the same manager but reaches no
caller in app-wear's main source today.

## Today

ExerciseSessionSystemImpl.endExerciseSession() calls
exerciseClient.endExerciseAsync() and discards the returned Task;
setDataDeliveryMode(mode) calls
exerciseClient.overrideBatchingModesForActiveExerciseAsync(overrides)
and discards its Task too. Both methods are plain (non-suspend)
functions, unlike startExerciseSession(), which already awaits
startExerciseAsync(config) via the file's own ListenableFuture.await()
extension and reports the outcome as ExerciseSessionStartOutcome.
Separately, in the same file family, DataLayerCapabilitySource's init
block (core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/link/WearableLinkStateSource.kt)
calls capabilityClient.addLocalCapability(CAPABILITY_NAME) and
discards its Task as well; this constructor runs once from each app's
DI module (app-phone's PlatformModule and app-wear's SyncModule) — the
same call site, reached from both sides, per
docs/CURRENT_TECHNICAL_STATE.md's own description of the class.

## Expected

endExerciseSession() and setDataDeliveryMode() become suspend and
await their Task the way startExerciseSession() already awaits
startExerciseAsync() — converting a failure into a reported outcome
instead of letting it pass unread. Their two callers are not suspend
contexts today: StopRaceController.stop() is a plain function returning
Result<Race> synchronously with no coroutine scope, and
EndOfRaceViewModel's init block runs outside viewModelScope. Neither
can call a suspend close() as currently written. [Second gap: both
callers need to launch a coroutine — StopRaceController.stop() and
EndOfRaceViewModel's init — before they can await the new close().]

Separately, DataLayerCapabilitySource awaits addLocalCapability(...)'s
Task the same way its own localNodeId() and reachableNodeIds() already
await theirs, reporting a failure the same way. The call sits in an
init block, which runs no coroutine; observeNodeConnected()'s
callbackFlow is the only coroutine this class runs today. [Second gap:
the capability call has to move out of init and into a suspend step
reached from observeNodeConnected(), since init itself cannot await
anything.]
